clips.title: 麦当劳推升级：加盟商承压，套餐12美元谁买单？

subtitles.en: So the big picture idea is that McDonald's wants to implement all these changes, basically to elevate its restaurants.
subtitles.zh: 总体思路是麦当劳想推行所有这些改变，基本上是为了提升餐厅档次。

subtitles.en: So think about hand breaded chicken, which is crispier than the nuggets.
subtitles.zh: 想想手工裹粉的鸡肉，比麦乐鸡更酥脆。

subtitles.en: Think about things like AI in the drive-thru, new designs in the restaurants.
subtitles.zh: 想想免下车取餐通道的AI，餐厅的新设计。

subtitles.en: And the thing is that frontiersies are basically pushing back because McDonald's is asking them to put up the money, you know, to make these changes
subtitles.zh: 问题是加盟商基本上在抵制，因为麦当劳要求他们出钱来做这些改变

subtitles.en: at a time when sales are actually slowing.
subtitles.zh: 而这个时候销售实际上在放缓。

subtitles.en: So frontiersies are basically saying, like, look, you know, between inflation, between slow and sales, we just don't have a lot of bandwidth to spend right now.
subtitles.zh: 所以加盟商基本上在说，你看，在通胀和销售放缓之间，我们现在没有太多余力花钱。

subtitles.en: And sales are slowing in part because prices have gone up. And, you know, McDonald's meal, I don't know if you know the price of your extra value meal off the top of your head.
subtitles.zh: 销售放缓部分是因为价格上涨。而且，麦当劳套餐，我不知道你是否记得超值套餐的价格。

subtitles.en: But when I go to McDonald's, it's easily $12, $13, which kind of strikes me as, I think I could get something healthier for the same amount of money.
subtitles.zh: 但我去麦当劳时，轻松就要12、13美元，这让我觉得，同样的钱我可以买到更健康的东西。

subtitles.en: The value proposition is not quite what it was. Is that something that McDonald's wants to correct or is it leaning towards catering to a more premium customer?
subtitles.zh: 价值主张不如从前了。这是麦当劳想纠正的，还是倾向于迎合更高端的客户？

subtitles.en: I think the interesting thing is that McDonald's wants to sort of do both things at once.
subtitles.zh: 我觉得有趣的是，麦当劳想同时做这两件事。

subtitles.en: So to your point, I mean, we got some data, you know, third party data showing that people just don't think that McDonald's is as good a deal as it used to and unlike how it is compared to peers, right?
subtitles.zh: 所以按你的说法，我们有些第三方数据显示，人们就是觉得麦当劳的性价比不如以前，跟同行比也不一样了，对吧？

subtitles.en: So even compared to their fast food chains, McDonald's shows us a rank as high on value.
subtitles.zh: 所以即使跟其他快餐连锁比，麦当劳在性价比上的排名也显得较高。

subtitles.en: But at the same time, it also ranks a little behind on things like taste, like quality and even like the vibe in the restaurant, like the atmosphere.
subtitles.zh: 但同时，它在口味、品质甚至餐厅氛围等方面也排名略靠后。

subtitles.en: So basically, as one of those big companies, it's kind of a generalist, right?
subtitles.zh: 所以基本上，作为大公司之一，它算是个多面手，对吧？
